keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Romelle Donovan (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sheffield United 0, Southampton 1. Lewis Dobbin (Southampton) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Zach Abbott (Southampton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Mads Roerslev (Southampton) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Patrick Bamford replaces Thomas Cannon.
Second Half begins Sheffield United 0, Southampton 1.
Oliver Arblaster (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Liam Kitching (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Southampton. Finn Azaz replaces Cameron Bragg.
Substitution, Southampton. James Bree replaces Mads Roerslev.
Substitution, Southampton. Cyle Larin replaces Divin Mubama.
Cyle Larin (Southampton) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Kalvin Phillips replaces Oliver Arblaster.
Substitution, Southampton. Samuel Edozie replaces Lewis Dobbin.
James Ward-Prowse (Southampton) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Tyrese Campbell replaces Tahith Chong.
Substitution, Southampton. Jack Stephens replaces Kuryu Matsuki.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Sam McCallum replaces Hamza Choudhury.
Goal! Sheffield United 1, Southampton 1. Sydie Peck (Sheffield United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jordan Ayew.
Delay in match because of an injury Welington (Southampton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Lamine Sidibe replaces Jordan Ayew.
